units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 1:11">Num. R. s. 1</cite> <he>לנ׳ שנכנס וכ׳</he> like unto a chief that entered a country.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 1:11">Ib.</cite> <he>שלא מנה נ׳ לשבט וכ׳</he> he appointed no prince for the tribe of Levi. [<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 1:11">Ib.</cite> <he>נשיא שבטים</he>, read <he>נְשִׂיאֵי</he>].
<cite ref="Mishnah Horayot 2:6">Hor. II, 6</cite>; a. v. fr.—Pl. <he>נְשִׂיאִים</he>.

Num. R. s. 12 למה נזדרזו הנ׳ וכ׳ why were the princes so anxious to be the first &c.? Num. R. s. 3; a. v. fr.—Esp. Nasi, the chief of the Great Sanhedrin in Jerusalem and of its successor in Palestinian places (v. אָב).
Pes. 66ᵃ מינוהו נ׳ עליהם they elected him as their Nasi; a. fr.—R. Judah the Nasi, v. רַבִּי.—Pl. as ab.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 32b:7">Kidd. 32ᵇ</cite> <he>להק״בה … מעלה נ׳ וכ׳</he> the Lord causes the wind to blow and brings up clouds and lets rain come down &c.
